meta.name: hellenist_sea_siege
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

programs.brief: A colossal sea monster breaches the harbor beside the city, with a towering wet body, fins, tentacles spilling over the quay, a glaring central eye and a foaming ground trace connecting the water to the city edge.

A varied invading sea monster with fins, tentacles, wet armored hide and a violent landing pose. Instances should form an advancing wave from the sea toward the city, with smaller craters, spray and broken paving around each arrival.

tokens.invasion: Sea monsters are invading the city.

children.label: A broad temperate coast with a raised urban shelf and a flooded inlet
A shallow rounded shelf for the city
The broad inlet through which the invasion reaches the city
Sparse temperate growth around the metropolitan edge
A formal modern Hellenist city on the inlet
A modern theater serving as the city's Hellenic civic landmark
The colossal monster breaking into the harbor
The offshore wave of monsters at the city's coast
The advancing monsters already inside the city
Formal roads connecting the city and its civic landmarks
